metrics.name: revenue_by_flow_order_matched
metrics.plain: Revenue each flow actually produced, counted from real orders, not from a click window
metrics.formula: sum of order revenue where the order's contact received a flow send in the N days before the order (N set per flow type, default 5 days email / 3 days SMS-WhatsApp), attributed to the last flow send before the order
metrics.source: orders table joined to esp_sends log
metrics.unavailable_when: orders and esp_sends cannot be joined on the same contact id
metrics.benchmark: welcome flow typically 3 to 5 percent of total email/SMS revenue for a healthy list; no universal number, compare to this brand's own trend

metrics.name: flow_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of people who got a flow and then bought
metrics.formula: orders attributed to flow ÷ unique contacts who entered the flow, trailing window
metrics.unavailable_when: flow entry log missing for that flow
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, compare within brand across flow versions

metrics.name: deliverability_inbox_placement
metrics.plain: Share of sends that land in the inbox, not spam or missing
metrics.formula: 1 minus (bounce rate + spam complaint rate), proxy when no seed-test data exists
metrics.source: ESP bounce and complaint logs, seed-test tool if connected
metrics.unavailable_when: no bounce or complaint feed from the ESP
metrics.benchmark: under 0.1 percent complaint rate, under 2 percent bounce rate is healthy

metrics.name: list_health_score
metrics.plain: One number for whether the list is getting healthier or riskier to mail
metrics.formula: composite of bounce rate, spam complaint rate, and share of contacts with 0 opens in 180 days, each normalized 0 to 1 and averaged
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 14 days without a refresh
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 4 weeks of send history
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch direction of travel

metrics.name: popup_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of visitors shown the pop-up who sign up
metrics.formula: pop-up sign-ups ÷ pop-up impressions
metrics.unavailable_when: pop-up tool does not log impressions
metrics.benchmark: 2 to 4 percent visitor-to-signup is a common range; treat as a comparison, not a target

metrics.name: time_to_first_purchase
metrics.plain: How long a new subscriber takes to buy for the first time
metrics.formula: median hours between signup timestamp and first order for subscribers who convert within 30 days
metrics.unavailable_when: signup timestamp not captured
metrics.benchmark: shorter is better; compare against the brand's own last quarter

metrics.name: sms_whatsapp_opt_in_rate
metrics.plain: Share of email subscribers who also opt in to SMS or WhatsApp
metrics.formula: contacts with a valid SMS or WhatsApp consent record ÷ contacts with a valid email consent record
metrics.unavailable_when: consent_log missing a channel
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, track growth over time

metrics.name: consent_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of active contacts with a valid, current consent record for every channel they are sent on
metrics.formula: contacts with a logged, unexpired consent record for channel X ÷ contacts sent on channel X in the window
metrics.unavailable_when: no consent_log
metrics.benchmark: target 100 percent; any gap is a compliance risk, not a growth metric

metrics.name: list_growth_net
metrics.plain: New contacts minus people who leave the list
metrics.formula: new opted-in contacts − (unsubscribes + hard bounces + suppressions)
metrics.unavailable_when: consent_log has gaps in the period
metrics.benchmark: should stay positive; a negative month is a flag

metrics.name: unsubscribe_rate_per_send
metrics.plain: Share of people who unsubscribe from a single send
metrics.formula: unsubscribes ÷ delivered, per campaign or flow send
metrics.unavailable_when: send-level unsubscribe not logged
metrics.benchmark: under 0.2 percent per send is typical; above 0.5 percent needs a content check

metrics.name: whatsapp_cod_to_prepaid_conversion
metrics.plain: Share of WhatsApp cart-recovery or order-update messages that convert a COD order to prepaid
metrics.formula: orders switched from COD to prepaid after a WhatsApp nudge ÷ COD orders that received the nudge
metrics.unavailable_when: no WhatsApp events log or no COD flag on the order
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target; India benchmark not public, track the brand's own baseline before and after the program

metrics.name: quiet_hours_violation_count
metrics.plain: Number of sends that went out outside the allowed local hours for that market
metrics.formula: count of esp_sends where sent_at local time falls outside the configured quiet-hours window for the contact's market
metrics.unavailable_when: contact market or local time zone unknown
metrics.benchmark: target zero

metrics.name: test_win_rate
metrics.plain: Share of tests in the queue that produced a real, pre-registered win
metrics.formula: tests marked won ÷ tests completed, where a win required hitting the pre-registered metric and sample size
metrics.unavailable_when: test_registry missing a result field
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch trend and hygiene violations

metrics.name: segment_freshness
metrics.plain: Days since a segment's definition was last recomputed against current data
metrics.formula: today minus last_computed_at, per segment
metrics.freshness_rule: flag stale after 7 days for RFM and buyer-stage segments
metrics.unavailable_when: segment has no last_computed_at
metrics.benchmark: under 7 days for behavior segments

metrics.name: welcome_flow_completion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of new subscribers who make it through the whole welcome sequence without unsubscribing
metrics.formula: contacts reaching final welcome step ÷ contacts entering step 1
metrics.unavailable_when: step-level flow log not available
metrics.benchmark: compare step to step, not to an outside number

metrics.name: winback_reactivation_rate
metrics.plain: Share of lapsed contacts in the win-back flow who place another order
metrics.formula: orders from win-back flow contacts ÷ contacts entering win-back
metrics.unavailable_when: flow entry not logged
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, track vs the brand's own prior version

metrics.name: flow_frequency_conflicts
metrics.plain: Number of contacts who got messages from 2 or more flows on the same day
metrics.formula: count of contact-days where esp_sends shows sends from more than one flow_id
metrics.unavailable_when: flow_id missing from send log
metrics.benchmark: target near zero, some overlap is unavoidable at high volume

metrics.name: channel_revenue_mix
metrics.plain: Share of lifecycle revenue coming from email vs SMS vs WhatsApp
metrics.formula: order-matched revenue per channel ÷ total order-matched lifecycle revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: channel field missing on a send
metrics.benchmark: no fixed split, watch for over-reliance on one channel

insights.name: flow revenue mismatch
insights.rule: the platform's reported flow revenue differs from order-matched flow revenue by more than 15 percent for a flow with at least 20 orders in the window
insights.sentence: {flow} shows {platform_rev} in your ESP but only {matched_rev} in real orders, a {pct} percent gap
insights.severity: high if gap over 30 percent, else medium

insights.name: quiet hours breach
insights.rule: quiet_hours_violation_count > 0 in the trailing 7 days
insights.sentence: {n} messages went out outside allowed hours in {market} this week

insights.name: flow collision
insights.rule: flow_frequency_conflicts for a contact-day pair exceeds a 5 percent share of active contacts in the trailing 7 days
insights.sentence: {n} contacts got messages from {k} flows on the same day this week

insights.name: deliverability drop
insights.rule: deliverability_inbox_placement falls more than 5 points versus its trailing 30-day average
insights.sentence: inbox placement dropped from {prev} to {now} percent this week

insights.name: stale segment
insights.rule: segment_freshness exceeds 7 days for a segment used by an active flow, while the underlying source data changed in that window
insights.sentence: {segment} has not recomputed in {n} days but still feeds {flow}

insights.name: discount fired too early
insights.rule: a cart or checkout abandonment flow's discount step index is at or before step 1 in flow_defs, against the brief's rule to hold discounts back
insights.sentence: {flow} offers a discount on message 1, before the shop-assistant follow-up gets a chance to work without one

insights.name: consent gap
insights.rule: a contact received a send on a channel with no matching valid consent record
insights.sentence: {n} sends this week went to contacts with no valid consent record on {channel}

insights.name: list decay
insights.rule: share of contacts with 0 opens or clicks in 180 days rises above 35 percent of the active list
insights.sentence: {pct} percent of your list has not engaged in 6 months, this is dragging deliverability down

insights.name: WhatsApp underused for high-value sends
insights.rule: a contact has a valid WhatsApp opt-in and a cart or order value above the brand's top quartile, but the send log shows SMS or email used instead
insights.sentence: {n} high-value sends this week used SMS or email even though the contact opted into WhatsApp

insights.name: welcome flow drop-off
insights.rule: the fall-off between two consecutive welcome steps exceeds twice the average step-to-step drop for that flow
insights.sentence: {pct} percent of new subscribers drop off between step {a} and step {b}

insights.name: win-back timing off brand cadence
insights.rule: the win-back flow's trigger delay is a fixed platform default rather than a value derived from this brand's own median days-between-orders
insights.sentence: win-back fires at {default} days but this brand's typical repeat buyer reorders at {median} days

insights.name: sunset not enforced
insights.rule: a contact has 0 opens across the last 6 sends and is still receiving campaigns, with no sunset flow entry logged
insights.sentence: {n} contacts with 6 unopened sends in a row are still being mailed campaigns

insights.name: test hygiene violation
insights.rule: a test in test_registry is marked complete with a sample size below its pre-registered minimum, or a read window shorter than pre-registered
insights.sentence: {test} was called before it reached {n} contacts or the {days}-day read window

insights.name: honesty rule breach
insights.rule: a live send contains a countdown timer or stock-scarcity claim with no matching inventory or time-limited-offer record
insights.sentence: {send} claims '{claim}' but there is no matching inventory or expiry record

insights.name: back-in-stock false trigger
insights.rule: a back-in-stock alert was sent for a SKU with no matching restock event in the inventory feed in the prior 24 hours
insights.sentence: a back-in-stock alert went out for {sku} with no restock event behind it

not_elsewhere.claim: Revenue by flow is counted from real orders matched to send logs, not from a click-attribution window that counts on send date and gives every touch its own credit
not_elsewhere.vs: Klaviyo's flow revenue reports revenue on the date the first message was sent, inside a configurable click window (default 5 days email, 1 day SMS), which can overstate or misdate a flow's real contribution

not_elsewhere.claim: One consent and quiet-hours record checked before every send across email, SMS and WhatsApp together
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Klaviyo and Gorgias separately for their own channel, but neither merges consent across every channel one brand sends on before a send goes out

not_elsewhere.claim: A pre-send honesty check that blocks a scarcity or countdown claim with no matching inventory or expiry record
not_elsewhere.vs: no ESP or SMS platform enforces this automatically; it is normally a manual copy-review step, if it happens at all

not_elsewhere.claim: Flow revenue mismatch between the platform's own report and real orders is surfaced as its own alert
not_elsewhere.vs: ESPs report their own attributed number with no way to see the gap against actual order data without exporting both and joining them by hand

not_elsewhere.claim: Test hygiene (minimum sample, pre-registered read window) is enforced across flows, campaigns and channels in one backlog
not_elsewhere.vs: Klaviyo's built-in A/B testing checks a single flow or campaign split, not a cross-channel test calendar with hygiene rules

not_elsewhere.claim: WhatsApp COD-to-prepaid conversion is tracked as its own metric tied to order data
not_elsewhere.vs: not a standard metric in Klaviyo, Gorgias or generic WhatsApp Business dashboards, which report delivery and read rates, not payment-method conversion

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, every metric shows unavailable and the room shows only the job list and empty chart frames, each with 'connect your ESP and order data to see this.' The first thing that lands once esp_sends and orders are connected is the flow revenue reconciliation chart and the consent-gap insight, since those need only 2 tables and catch the most urgent problems (money being miscounted, and sends that should not have gone out). WhatsApp-specific metrics stay unavailable until a WhatsApp Business or BSP feed is connected, which is normally the last piece for an Indian brand.

metrics.name: repeat_purchase_rate
metrics.plain: Share of first-time buyers who order again within a set window
metrics.formula: customers with a 2nd order within 90 days ÷ customers with a 1st order in the cohort
metrics.window: rolling by acquisition month, viewed at 30/60/90/180 days
metrics.unavailable_when: orders lack a stable customer id
metrics.benchmark: varies hugely by category; compare within brand across cohorts, not to an outside number

metrics.name: cohort_gross_profit_ltv
metrics.plain: What a cohort of customers is actually worth in profit, not sales, over time
metrics.formula: cumulative (order revenue − COGS − payment fees − return/refund cost − shipping cost − support cost allocated to that customer) per customer, grouped by first-order month
metrics.window: by acquisition month, viewed to 3/6/12 months
metrics.unavailable_when: COGS or return cost data missing for the period
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; the target is LTV covering CAC within the brand's own payback window

metrics.name: cac_ltv_ratio
metrics.plain: Whether a customer is worth more than it cost to get them
metrics.formula: cohort_gross_profit_ltv at 180 days ÷ blended CAC for that cohort's acquisition channel
metrics.unavailable_when: CAC by cohort not available
metrics.benchmark: commonly cited healthy range is 3:1 or higher, but treat as directional

metrics.name: wismo_ticket_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders that generate a 'where is my order' contact
metrics.formula: tickets tagged as delivery-status ÷ total orders in the same window
metrics.unavailable_when: tickets are not tagged by reason
metrics.benchmark: under 5 percent of orders is a common target for a healthy tracking experience

metrics.name: rto_rate_cod
metrics.plain: Share of COD orders that come back undelivered
metrics.formula: RTO-flagged COD orders ÷ total COD orders shipped
metrics.window: trailing 30 and 90 days, by pincode or zone
metrics.unavailable_when: courier feed has no RTO flag
metrics.benchmark: India COD RTO commonly runs 15 to 30 percent depending on category and geography; compare to the brand's own trend and zone spread

metrics.name: return_rate
metrics.plain: Share of delivered orders that come back as a return or exchange
metrics.formula: returned units ÷ delivered units
metrics.window: trailing 90 days, by SKU and reason
metrics.unavailable_when: returns not logged with a SKU and reason
metrics.benchmark: varies by category; watch trend and reason mix, not a fixed number

metrics.name: refund_cycle_time
metrics.plain: How long a refund takes from request to money back
metrics.formula: median hours between return_requested_at and refund_issued_at
metrics.unavailable_when: either timestamp missing
metrics.benchmark: under 5 to 7 business days is a common customer expectation

metrics.name: nps_score
metrics.plain: Net promoter score from the standing survey
metrics.formula: percent promoters (9 to 10) minus percent detractors (0 to 6)
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 45 days without new responses
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 responses in the window
metrics.benchmark: no universal number; track trend and compare against own history

metrics.name: support_csat
metrics.plain: Average satisfaction score after a support interaction
metrics.formula: mean CSAT score from post-ticket surveys, 1 to 5 or thumbs scale normalized to percent
metrics.unavailable_when: CSAT survey not sent or response rate under 5 percent
metrics.benchmark: above 90 percent thumbs-up is a common healthy target

metrics.name: ticket_volume_by_reason
metrics.plain: How many tickets come in for each reason
metrics.formula: count of support_tickets grouped by reason_tag
metrics.unavailable_when: tickets untagged
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch which reason is growing fastest

metrics.name: first_response_time
metrics.plain: How fast support answers a new ticket
metrics.formula: median minutes between ticket opened and first agent or AI reply
metrics.unavailable_when: reply timestamp missing
metrics.benchmark: under 1 hour for chat/WhatsApp, under 24 hours for email is a common target

metrics.name: churn_risk_distribution
metrics.plain: How many customers sit in each churn-risk tier
metrics.formula: count of contacts per tier from the churn score (RFM decay + subscription pause events + unresolved tickets + engagement drop)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 90 days of order history
metrics.benchmark: no fixed split, watch the high-risk tier size over time

metrics.name: true_customer_profitability
metrics.plain: What a customer is actually worth after every real cost, not just what they spent
metrics.formula: customer revenue − returns/refund cost − support cost allocated (tickets × average handle cost) − shipping cost − discount cost given
metrics.source: orders + refunds + support_tickets + shipping cost table + discount_codes
metrics.window: trailing 12 months, per customer and per tier
metrics.unavailable_when: support cost or shipping cost cannot be allocated per order
metrics.benchmark: compare tiers to each other, not to an outside number

metrics.name: identity_match_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders, tickets and marketing contacts successfully merged into one profile per real person
metrics.formula: records matched to a unified profile ÷ total records checked (orders + tickets + ESP contacts + loyalty)
metrics.unavailable_when: identity resolution not run
metrics.benchmark: target close to 100 percent; a low rate understates real repeat rate and LTV

metrics.name: gst_credit_note_reconciliation_rate
metrics.plain: Share of completed refunds that have a matching, filed GST credit note
metrics.formula: refunds with a linked, filed credit_note_id ÷ total completed refunds
metrics.window: trailing month, checked monthly for GST filing
metrics.freshness_rule: recompute weekly, hard check before each GST filing date
metrics.unavailable_when: credit note system not linked to refunds
metrics.benchmark: target 100 percent before each filing deadline

metrics.name: dpdp_request_sla_compliance
metrics.plain: Share of data access or erasure requests handled inside the legal deadline
metrics.formula: requests resolved on or before their SLA deadline ÷ total requests received
metrics.freshness_rule: recompute daily while any request is open
metrics.unavailable_when: no dpdp_requests log kept
metrics.benchmark: target 100 percent, this is a legal obligation not a growth metric

metrics.name: ndr_reschedule_success_rate
metrics.plain: Share of failed COD delivery attempts that get successfully rebooked
metrics.formula: NDR'd orders successfully redelivered ÷ total NDR'd orders
metrics.unavailable_when: courier has no NDR event feed
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, compare couriers against each other

metrics.name: cx_maturity_score
metrics.plain: Whether CX decisions are random, intentional, or genuinely differentiated
metrics.formula: scored checklist against a written experience standard (LIFE-C30), not a computed ratio
metrics.source: manual scoring against the standard, logged with date
metrics.unavailable_when: no standard has been written yet
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, this is a maturity stage, not a number to beat

metrics.name: marketplace_review_rating
metrics.plain: Average public rating on marketplaces and Google, next to the on-site rating for the same product
metrics.formula: mean star rating per SKU, per source (Google Business Profile, Amazon, Flipkart, on-site)
metrics.unavailable_when: marketplace review pull not connected for that platform
metrics.benchmark: gap of more than 0.5 stars between on-site and marketplace rating for the same SKU is worth investigating

insights.name: silent churn risk
insights.rule: a customer's RFM recency decays past their own historical repurchase window, with no support contact and no email/SMS engagement in the same period
insights.sentence: {n} customers are past their usual reorder window with zero contact from us or to us

insights.name: refund without credit note
insights.rule: a refund is marked completed with no linked, filed GST credit note after 15 days
insights.sentence: {n} refunds from the last filing period have no matching credit note on file

insights.name: unprofitable VIP
insights.rule: a customer tagged VIP by revenue shows negative true_customer_profitability over the trailing 12 months
insights.sentence: {n} of your VIP customers are actually unprofitable once returns and support cost are counted

insights.name: unanswered negative review
insights.rule: a review rated 2 stars or lower has no response after 5 days
insights.sentence: {n} reviews at 2 stars or below have gone unanswered for over 5 days

insights.name: NDR loop
insights.rule: the same order has 2 or more failed delivery attempts with no successful reschedule
insights.sentence: order {id} has failed delivery {n} times with no successful rebooking

insights.name: crisis signal
insights.rule: mentions of one complaint theme across public channels (reviews, socials, forums) more than triples the trailing 14-day average in a single day
insights.sentence: mentions of '{theme}' are {n} times the normal rate today

insights.name: DPDP deadline at risk
insights.rule: an open data request is within 3 days of its legal SLA deadline and not yet resolved
insights.sentence: request {id} is due in {n} days and is still open

insights.name: identity fragmentation
insights.rule: the same phone number or email appears on more than one unmerged profile with orders on both
insights.sentence: {n} customers likely have 2 or more unmerged profiles, understating real repeat rate

insights.name: ticket reason drift
insights.rule: one reason_tag's share of total ticket volume grows more than 10 percentage points month over month
insights.sentence: '{reason}' tickets went from {a}% to {b}% of contacts this month

insights.name: RTO concentrated in one zone
insights.rule: a pincode cluster or courier shows an RTO rate more than double the brand's overall rate, with at least 20 orders in the window
insights.sentence: {zone} is running {n}x the average RTO rate on {count} orders this month

insights.name: marketplace rating gap
insights.rule: a SKU's marketplace rating is more than 0.5 stars below its on-site rating, with at least 10 marketplace reviews
insights.sentence: {sku} rates {onsite} stars on-site but only {market} on {platform}

insights.name: AI agent overreach
insights.rule: a logged AI support agent action exceeds its configured autonomy cap (refund amount, address change scope, or action type not on the approved list)
insights.sentence: the AI agent took action '{action}' worth {amount}, above its {cap} cap

insights.name: marketplace seller queue backlog
insights.rule: marketplace seller-support tickets aging past the marketplace's own SLA and still open
insights.sentence: {n} marketplace buyer messages on {platform} are past SLA and unanswered

insights.name: WISMO surge in one lane
insights.rule: wismo_ticket_rate for a shipping zone or courier exceeds 2x the brand overall rate
insights.sentence: {zone} is generating {n}x the normal share of 'where is my order' tickets

visuals.name: cohort profit curve
visuals.shows: cumulative gross-profit LTV by acquisition month, at 30/60/90/180/365 days
visuals.why_this_chart: shows which acquisition months are actually paying back, not just which had the most orders

visuals.name: WISMO and delivery funnel
visuals.shows: orders shipped, orders delayed, WISMO tickets raised, tickets resolved
visuals.why_this_chart: connects a delivery problem straight to the support cost it creates

visuals.name: RTO by zone map

not_elsewhere.claim: Lifetime value is computed on gross profit after returns, support and discount cost, not on revenue
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's native LTV and cohort reports are revenue based and, outside Shopify Plus, do not offer cohort analysis at all; Triple Whale's cohort tools are also built on revenue and ad spend, not on returns and support cost netted out

not_elsewhere.claim: COD RTO and failed-delivery (NDR) reschedule outcomes are tracked as their own funnel tied to real courier events
not_elsewhere.vs: not a standard view in Klaviyo, Gorgias or Shopify analytics, which do not carry courier delivery-attempt data

not_elsewhere.claim: Support ticket reasons and CSAT are shown next to return, RTO and true-profitability data in one room
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Gorgias for ticket reasons and CSAT alone; Gorgias has no view of returns cost, RTO or per-customer profitability

not_elsewhere.claim: A single DPDP data-request register that tracks every system holding a person's data, with a legal SLA clock
not_elsewhere.vs: no ecommerce tool ships this off the shelf, since the data spans the ESP, helpdesk, loyalty app, POS and marketplace accounts a brand uses

not_elsewhere.claim: One merged customer identity across guest checkouts, phone, WhatsApp numbers, POS and marketplace orders before churn or LTV is scored
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify and most ESPs treat a guest checkout, a repeat email and a marketplace order as separate records unless a paid CDP is added; this identity resolution is a prerequisite step here, not an add-on

not_elsewhere.claim: An AI support agent's exact autonomy limits (refund cap, allowed action types) are logged and checked against every action it actually takes
not_elsewhere.vs: off-the-shelf AI helpdesk agents surface a config screen for the limits, but few log and flag when an action approaches or crosses that limit automatically

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows the job list and unavailable states everywhere except cx_maturity_score, which only needs a manual scoring session against a written standard. The first real signal once orders and refunds are connected is repeat_purchase_rate and return_rate; true_customer_profitability and cohort_gross_profit_ltv need support_tickets and product_costs on top of that, so they light up later. DPDP and GST reconciliation fields are the hardest to get since they live outside any marketing or CX tool, in accounting and a manual compliance log.

jobs.job: design the offer's full value proposition
jobs.question: does this offer actually beat the buyer's single biggest objection, priced and proven

jobs.job: model offer and discount economics before launch
jobs.question: what does this discount actually cost in margin, and does it cross my red line

jobs.job: govern discount policy and price integrity
jobs.question: are we training buyers to wait for a discount

jobs.job: design bundles and quantity-ladder pricing
jobs.question: does every tier in this ladder have a real reason to exist, and is the middle one winning

jobs.job: design gift-with-purchase offers
jobs.question: is this gift lifting the tier we want, or just costing margin for no shift in behavior

jobs.job: place upsell and cross-sell offers
jobs.question: which placements are actually converting, and are they hurting margin anywhere

jobs.job: design the guarantee and risk-reversal offer
jobs.question: does the guarantee remove real buyer risk without breaking margin if claims run high

jobs.job: design the subscription offer and cancel flow
jobs.question: is the reason to subscribe stronger than a flat discount, and is the cancel-save offer working

jobs.job: design and model the pop-up first-order offer
jobs.question: does the pop-up offer pay for itself once opt-ins, discount cost and ESP cost are counted

jobs.job: design referral and partner offers
jobs.question: is referral acquiring customers cheaper than paid media

jobs.job: design payment terms, BNPL and trial pricing
jobs.question: is the trial-to-full conversion rate matching what we modeled when we priced it

jobs.job: run the offer testing framework
jobs.question: what should be tested next, and is any test running so it can't be trusted

jobs.job: track competitor and MAP pricing
jobs.question: did a named competitor or reseller just move price on us

jobs.job: run the gift card program
jobs.question: how much outstanding gift card liability are we carrying, and is it being redeemed

metrics.name: margin_after_discount
metrics.plain: What is actually left after the discount, in rupees, not just percent off
metrics.formula: order revenue − COGS − payment fee − discount amount, per order and rolled up per offer
metrics.unavailable_when: COGS missing for a SKU in the order
metrics.benchmark: compare against the founder's own red-line margin, set per offer

metrics.name: free_shipping_threshold_breakeven
metrics.plain: The order value at which free shipping stops costing margin
metrics.formula: AOV + (average shipping cost ÷ gross margin rate), recomputed from the brand's live numbers
metrics.window: recomputed monthly or when AOV/margin shifts more than 5 percent
metrics.freshness_rule: flag stale if AOV or shipping cost has moved over 5 percent since last computed
metrics.unavailable_when: shipping cost per order not tracked separately
metrics.benchmark: a common range is 20 to 30 percent above current AOV, but the brand's own break-even number is what matters

metrics.name: discount_dependency_rate
metrics.plain: Share of revenue that only came in at a discount
metrics.formula: revenue from orders with a discount code or automatic discount ÷ total revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: discount flag missing on the order
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch the trend line for creep

metrics.name: discount_frequency_per_customer
metrics.plain: How often the same customer buys only when there is a discount
metrics.formula: count of discounted orders ÷ total orders, per repeat customer
metrics.unavailable_when: customer id missing on some orders
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; a rising trend per customer signals trained-to-wait behavior

metrics.name: bundle_attach_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders that take the bundle instead of a single item
metrics.formula: bundle orders ÷ (bundle orders + single-item orders for the same product line)
metrics.unavailable_when: bundle SKU not distinguished from single SKU
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; compare tiers against each other

metrics.name: average_selling_price_trend
metrics.plain: Whether the real price paid, after discounts, is rising or falling over time
metrics.formula: total revenue ÷ total units, monthly
metrics.unavailable_when: unit count missing on an order
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch direction relative to list price

metrics.name: gwp_cost_share
metrics.plain: What the free gift costs as a share of the order it is attached to
metrics.formula: gift COGS ÷ order revenue, for orders that received the gift
metrics.unavailable_when: gift COGS not entered
metrics.benchmark: compare against the cap the founder set when the gift was designed

metrics.name: upsell_take_rate
metrics.plain: Share of eligible customers who accept an upsell or cross-sell offer
metrics.formula: orders that included the upsell ÷ orders shown the upsell, by placement (cart, checkout, post-purchase)
metrics.unavailable_when: the placement does not log an impression
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; compare placements to each other

metrics.name: guarantee_claim_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders covered by the guarantee that actually file a claim
metrics.formula: guarantee claims ÷ orders covered by that guarantee, in the guarantee's window
metrics.source: refunds tagged as guarantee claims + orders
metrics.unavailable_when: claims not tagged separately from ordinary returns
metrics.benchmark: compare against the claim-rate assumption used when the guarantee was priced

metrics.name: subscription_perk_redemption_rate
metrics.plain: Share of subscribers who actually use a given perk
metrics.formula: perk redemptions ÷ active subscribers eligible for that perk
metrics.unavailable_when: redemption not logged per perk
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target; a very low rate signals the wrong perk

metrics.name: cancel_flow_save_rate
metrics.plain: Share of subscribers who accept the save offer instead of cancelling
metrics.formula: saves ÷ (saves + completed cancellations)
metrics.unavailable_when: cancel-flow steps not logged
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, watch trend over time

metrics.name: popup_offer_net_economics
metrics.plain: Whether the pop-up offer pays for itself once every cost is counted
metrics.formula: incremental revenue from pop-up-sourced first orders − (discount cost + ESP cost allocated to those contacts)
metrics.source: orders + consent_log signup source + discount_codes + ESP cost
metrics.unavailable_when: signup source not tagged on the contact
metrics.benchmark: target positive net; compare against the model built before launch (LIFE-C44)

metrics.name: referral_program_cac
metrics.plain: Cost to acquire a customer through referral, versus paid CAC
metrics.formula: total referral reward cost ÷ number of referred customers who placed an order
metrics.unavailable_when: referral source not tagged on the order
metrics.benchmark: compare directly against blended paid CAC for the same period

metrics.name: bnpl_trial_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of trial or BNPL starts that convert to the full-price plan
metrics.formula: trials converted to full price ÷ trials started
metrics.unavailable_when: trial conversion not logged
metrics.benchmark: compare against the conversion assumption used when the trial was priced

metrics.name: map_violation_count
metrics.plain: Number of listings selling below the agreed minimum advertised price
metrics.formula: count of marketplace_listings rows where listed_price < map_price
metrics.unavailable_when: a marketplace or reseller is not covered by the price pull
metrics.benchmark: target zero

metrics.name: competitor_price_index
metrics.plain: The brand's price versus named competitors, indexed
metrics.formula: brand price ÷ average of named competitors' price for the matched product, per SKU family
metrics.freshness_rule: recompute on each competitor price pull
metrics.unavailable_when: no matched competitor SKU found
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch material moves (over 5 percent) more than the absolute index

metrics.name: gift_card_liability_outstanding
metrics.plain: Total value of gift cards sold but not yet redeemed
metrics.formula: sum of issued_value − sum of redeemed_value, across active cards
metrics.unavailable_when: gift card ledger not exported
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch growth rate against redemption rate

metrics.name: gift_card_redemption_rate
metrics.plain: Share of issued gift card value that gets redeemed
metrics.formula: redeemed value ÷ issued value, for cards past their typical redemption window
metrics.window: trailing 12 months of issuance, redemption tracked ongoing
metrics.unavailable_when: issuance date missing
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; a falling rate alongside rising liability is the flag

metrics.name: offer_test_backlog_status
metrics.plain: What is queued, running or done in the offer test backlog, and the win rate
metrics.formula: count and status of entries in the offer test registry; win rate = tests won ÷ tests completed
metrics.unavailable_when: test_registry not kept for offers specifically
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch hygiene violations alongside win rate

insights.name: discount creep
insights.rule: discount_dependency_rate rises more than 5 percentage points over the trailing 3 months
insights.sentence: discounted revenue went from {a}% to {b}% of sales over the last 3 months

insights.name: margin red line breach
insights.rule: margin_after_discount for a live offer falls below the founder's stated red-line margin
insights.sentence: {offer} is running at {margin}% margin, below your {redline}% red line

insights.name: MAP violation detected
insights.rule: map_violation_count > 0 for a listing in the current check
insights.sentence: {n} listings on {marketplace} are priced below the agreed MAP of {map_price}

insights.name: free shipping threshold stale
insights.rule: free_shipping_threshold_breakeven has not been recomputed since AOV or shipping cost moved more than 5 percent
insights.sentence: your free shipping threshold was set when AOV was {old}, it is now {new}

insights.name: bundle cannibalizing full price
insights.rule: bundle_attach_rate is high (over 40 percent) while average_selling_price_trend for the product line is falling faster than the bundle's per-unit discount would explain
insights.sentence: the bundle is winning {pct}% of orders but per-unit price is falling faster than the bundle discount accounts for

insights.name: gift cost creep with no lift
insights.rule: gwp_cost_share rises without a matching rise in average_selling_price_trend or bundle_attach_rate for the tier the gift was meant to lift
insights.sentence: the gift now costs {pct}% of order value with no lift in the tier it was meant to push

insights.name: guarantee cost above plan
insights.rule: guarantee_claim_rate exceeds the claim-rate assumption used to price the guarantee by more than 50 percent relative
insights.sentence: claims are running at {actual}%, against a planned {planned}%

insights.name: trial conversion miss
insights.rule: bnpl_trial_conversion_rate falls more than 20 percent relative below the modeled conversion used to price the trial
insights.sentence: trial-to-full conversion is {actual}%, against a modeled {planned}%

insights.name: competitor price move
insights.rule: competitor_price_index moves more than 5 percent in either direction for a named competitor's matched SKU family within a week
insights.sentence: {competitor} moved price {pct}% on {product} this week

insights.name: referral beats paid CAC
insights.rule: referral_program_cac is less than half of blended paid CAC for the same period
insights.sentence: referral CAC is {referral}, less than half of paid CAC at {paid}

insights.name: overlapping offer tests
insights.rule: two entries in the offer test_registry target the same product or segment with overlapping date ranges
insights.sentence: {test_a} and {test_b} are both running on {segment} at the same time, results cannot be trusted

insights.name: gift card liability outpacing redemption
insights.rule: gift_card_liability_outstanding grows faster than gift_card_redemption_rate over 3 consecutive months
insights.sentence: outstanding gift card liability has grown {pct}% while redemption has not kept pace

insights.name: subscription perk mismatch
insights.rule: subscription_perk_redemption_rate for a perk stays under 10 percent for 2 consecutive months
insights.sentence: only {pct}% of subscribers use the '{perk}' perk 2 months running

insights.name: cancel save rate falling
insights.rule: cancel_flow_save_rate drops more than 10 percentage points versus its trailing 90-day average
insights.sentence: the cancel-flow save offer worked {old}% of the time, now {new}%

insights.name: competitor policy change
insights.rule: a named competitor's public returns, loyalty or subscription-terms page changes materially since the last check
insights.sentence: {competitor} changed its {policy_type} page: {change}

visuals.name: margin waterfall
visuals.shows: revenue down to net margin for a chosen offer or discount, step by step
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder needs to see exactly where money leaves before approving an offer, not just a final percent

visuals.name: discount dependency trend
visuals.shows: share of revenue at a discount, monthly, over the trailing 12 months
visuals.why_this_chart: discount creep is invisible month to month but obvious as a trend line

visuals.name: free shipping threshold sensitivity
visuals.shows: break-even threshold recalculated as AOV, margin or shipping cost inputs change
visuals.why_this_chart: shows the founder the current live number and how sensitive it is to what just changed

visuals.name: competitor price index
visuals.shows: brand price index versus each named competitor over time
visuals.why_this_chart: a single moment snapshot hides a slow squeeze; the line shows the trend

visuals.name: bundle ladder funnel
visuals.shows: share of orders choosing each tier in the ladder, single item to largest bundle
visuals.why_this_chart: shows whether the pre-selected middle option is actually winning

visuals.name: offer test backlog board
visuals.shows: offer tests planned, running, done, with hygiene flags
visuals.why_this_chart: keeps one variable tested at a time visible instead of buried in separate documents

visuals.name: gift card liability vs redemption
visuals.shows: outstanding liability and redemption rate over time
visuals.why_this_chart: liability growth is a cash-flow risk that is easy to miss without seeing both lines together

not_elsewhere.claim: The free shipping threshold is computed straight from this brand's own live AOV, margin and shipping cost, and flagged stale automatically when those inputs move
not_elsewhere.vs: standalone calculators such as Funnelytics or Cartylabs use the same break-even formula but need the numbers typed in by hand each time, with no link to the brand's own order data and no automatic re-check

not_elsewhere.claim: A margin waterfall runs before an offer launches, and a founder-set red line blocks approval if it is crossed
not_elsewhere.vs: no researched tool ties a margin model to a hard approval gate before an offer goes live; discount apps in Shopify show usage after the fact, not a pre-launch margin check

not_elsewhere.claim: Discount dependency and price integrity are tracked as one running score across every offer and channel, not just a discount-usage count
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's and most ESPs' discount reports show redemption counts and revenue per code, not a trained-to-wait signal across the whole account

not_elsewhere.claim: Competitor and MAP price tracking is tied directly into the brand's own offer test backlog and margin data
not_elsewhere.vs: standalone MAP-monitoring services flag violations but do not connect to the brand's own cost and margin data to show what a match or hold would actually cost

not_elsewhere.claim: Offer tests are checked for overlap (same segment, same window, two variables at once) automatically before a founder is asked to read results
not_elsewhere.vs: most brands track offer tests in a spreadsheet with no automatic overlap check, so a confounded result can look clean

not_elsewhere.claim: Gift card liability and redemption are shown together as a cash-flow signal, not just a balance
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's native gift card report shows a balance, not a trend of liability growth against redemption pace

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows the job list, empty chart frames and one usable tile: the margin waterfall template, which a founder can fill by hand before any data is connected since it only needs a proposed price, COGS and discount. The first real numbers to land once orders and product_costs are connected are margin_after_discount and discount_dependency_rate. Competitor and MAP pricing depend on the agent's own public web pulls and are the hardest to keep current, since prices change without notice and matching a competitor's SKU to the brand's own is manual work the first time.
